description: Ingest Kustomer conversations via the Search API (POST /v1/customers/search, queryContext=conversation) and return a pandas DataFrame.

outputs.description: DataFrame of Kustomer conversation records (flattened from JSON:API attributes)

asset_name.label: Asset Name
asset_name.description: Name of the asset to create

resource_name.label: Resource Name
resource_name.description: Key of the KustomerResource this asset depends on for authentication

from_date_time.label: From Date/Time
from_date_time.description: Start of the conversation window (ISO-8601). Passed as a server-side conversation_created_at >= filter on the Search API.

to_date_time.label: To Date/Time
to_date_time.description: End of the conversation window (ISO-8601). Passed as a server-side conversation_created_at < filter.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of conversations to fetch across all pages

page_size.label: Page Size
page_size.description: Conversations requested per page (Kustomer's documented max page size)

max_pages.label: Max Pages
max_pages.description: Safety cap on the number of search pages walked, regardless of limit

owners.label: Owners
owners.description: Asset owners — team names (team:support) or email addresses.

asset_tags.label: Asset Tags
asset_tags.description: Key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog.

kinds.label: Kinds
kinds.description: Asset kinds shown in the Dagster catalog. Defaults to ['kustomer', 'python'].

include_preview_metadata.label: Include Preview Metadata
include_preview_metadata.description: Include sample data preview in metadata

preview_rows.label: Preview Rows
preview_rows.description: Rows to include in the preview metadata

deps.label: Deps
deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime)

partition_start.label: Partition Start
partition_start.description: Partition start date in ISO format, e.g. '2024-01-01'. Required for time-based partition types.

partition_values.label: Partition Values
partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning, e.g. 'us,eu,asia'.

partition_dimensions.label: Partition Dimensions
partition_dimensions.description: Multi-axis partition spec: list of {name, type, start, values, dynamic_partition_name} dicts. Overrides flat fields when set.

name: Kustomer Conversations Ingestion
